purpose: Bounded implicit stiffness support instrument; synthetic, not physical grade calibration
controls: Identical restraints, load and stiffness; LAW1 HEX8 versus LAW117 TYPE43

time_history.force_semantics: REACZ is stored as impulse in T01; use the generated T01_TITLES sidecar with official th_to_csv to derive reaction force
time_history.force_channel: /TH/NODE/101 REACZ on bottom nodes 1-4; sum the signed normal reactions
time_history.displacement_channel: /TH/NODE/102 DZ on top nodes 5-8; average the four values
time_history.energy_channel: /TH/BRIC/103 IE for brick 1, in N mm
